question: The release approval source is temporarily unavailable, but the implementation issue is done. May I promise the wider rollout now?

claims.text: No; the wider rollout cannot be promised. INT-210 implementation is Done, but commercial launch remains Pending approval.

supports.quote: INT-210 implementation is Done; commercial launch remains Pending approval.

claims.text: Code completion does not constitute approval for general customer release, so completion of PAY-102 alone cannot support a rollout promise.

supports.quote: PAY-102 code fix: Done. Code completion does not approve general customer release.

claims.text: Payment-retry is limited to the controlled pilot; GA is not approved and no general release date is confirmed.

supports.quote: Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved. No general release date is confirmed.

claims.text: When current source access cannot be verified, a prior allow decision must not be treated as current permission.

supports.quote: When current source access cannot be verified, do not treat a prior allow decision as current permission.
